correctness.rationale: For a rank-one map φ(−)U, evaluating the anti identity at φ(X)=φ(Y)=1 forces U²=λU; taking one argument in ker φ forces each multiplication functional to be proportional to φ. Testing matrix units verifies trace nondegeneracy without a restriction on characteristic. With φ=tr(V−), this is the equivalent system VU=aV, UV=bV, λ+a+b=0. When λ=0, a²=b²=0, so both vanish; otherwise normalize the output generator to the unique idempotent E on its line, and the eigenvalues must be 0 or 1. The condition 1+a+b=0 then gives exactly the two characteristic-two off-diagonal corners or the one characteristic-three diagonal corner. The composition square is tr(VE)R for normalized E and vanishes off the characteristic-three branch (use trace cyclicity for the off-diagonal corners). The strong identity for idempotent output would force ker φ⊆ker(−·E), impossible since right multiplication by E has rank n·rank E≥2. For the census, choosing image, kernel, and quotient-to-image isomorphism counts square-zero U; dividing by q−1 parametrizes image lines, and V then factors from k^n/im U to ker U. Ordered complementary subspaces count E and the block dimensions count V. Trace on M_r is surjective via a single diagonal matrix unit, even when the characteristic divides r, so each nonzero composition scalar has exactly the stated fiber size.
residual_risks: Recorded small-field checker outputs are corroboration, not an independent rerun. The classification over arbitrary fields and finite-field formulas rely on the algebraic argument.

value.rationale: Rank one is the natural first linear-rank cutoff for these operators. The full-matrix classification separates the sign-sensitive characteristic-three branch from the previously known zero-square census, determines exactly when nonnilpotence occurs, and measures it by a count for every scalar. This is more informative than either exercising the standard square-zero case or exhibiting a single low-dimensional operator.
residual_risks: The value does not depend on an extrapolation to higher rank or on claiming that the known characteristic-two formulas are new.
